title: Pinarello F5 Road Bike Negative Points

takeaways.text: The position suited him so well that he changed nothing, including on the hoods and on descents.
Compared with a Dogma F it is about 800 g heavier, noticeable mainly when accelerating; a lighter cockpit would help.
The T700 frame flexes slightly in the first hard pedal strokes above about 800 W, which lighter or less powerful riders may not notice; it descends as well as the Dogma F12 he rode.

disclosure: The channel runs a promotion for its own clothing; how the bike was obtained is not stated.
summary: A rider's follow-up on the Pinarello F5 comparing it with the Dogma F.
